| `qrcode.min.js` | qrcode-generator 1.4.4 by Kazuhiko Arase | https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/qrcode-generator/1.4.4/qrcode.min.js (downloaded 2026-10-23) | MIT — https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator/blob/master/LICENSE |
